args.title: Tamarack Warehouse Automation 2026 — Combined Summary
args.body:
- Pick rates rose 18% in 2026 with the adoption of autonomous carts (main article: blog.tamarack.example/2026/warehouse).
- Integration took twice as long as planned, a key implementation caveat from the main article.
- The biggest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks, per the companion piece (insights.tamarack.example/warehouse/companion).
